Concurrent exact STARTs join the same authorization and worker. A lost START answer after durable acceptance is confirmed from the record and continues the same logical attempt and fence instead of writing DEFERRED and re-registering; a truly unaccepted delivery may defer. Stale or different-payload STARTs cannot install work or borrow a prior acknowledgement. A newer attempt is admissible only after explicit predecessor quiescence, and recovery of an accepted START resumes the same attempt without fabricating predecessor progress.
